title: Ganga Gowri
desc: Shiva, who is in love with Ganga, must marry another woman to pay off his debt. However, what begins as a marriage of necessity quickly evolves into something more.

title: Chinna Marumagal
desc: The eldest daughter-in-law of a family faces various hardships at the hands of her mother-in-law. The youngest daughter-in-law teaches her a lesson and makes her realise her mistakes.

title: Ramakrishna
desc: Ramakrishna, a millionaire, stays with his mother and is not in touch with anyone from his family. After her death, he decides to go to the village in search of his long-lost relatives.
